## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

The *Saṅgahavāra* ("The classes of offenses to which each rule belongs") is an analytical section of the *Parivāra*, the final treatise of the Theravāda *Vinaya Piṭaka*. The chapter systematically examines monastic infractions, defining which rules may fall under the heading or classification of other rules. A complete English translation of the section has been published by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

None of the passages located in the reference search discuss this Vinaya text; occurrences of the title *saṅgahavāra* in the searched corpus pertain instead to the summary section of the Abhidhamma *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*, while other matching references pertain to unrelated compendia containing the word *saṅgaha*, primarily the *Abhidhammatthasaṅgaha*.
